A.note: Team mode, a countdown and a 4-choice quiz labelled 1/10 actually run, which suits classroom use, and the question and choices are accurate. The title's '복습' runs up into the line above, the decorative icons have nothing to do with digestion, and there is no diagram of the organs.

B.note: A polished body-map illustration and three stages (find the organ, what it does, order of travel) look well made. But the text is very small and hard to read, and the screen does not change after the button presses, so only the first question can be checked.

C.note: The best-looking of the four: a large, clear title, a labelled organ diagram, 10 questions in three categories, and solo or two-team modes. After the button presses it stays on question 1, so how the game continues cannot be seen.

D.note: Four modes (learn, find the organ, quiz, food's journey) and a clickable diagram that shows the path food takes and which organs it skips. The text and diagram labels are very small, much of the screen is empty, and the layout looks plain.
